task_text: 核查以下声明，搜索外部证据。依据实际证据回答，说明结论范围与不确定性：In 2018, Yaba Psychiatric Hospital had a budget of 133 million Nairas, but less than 10% of that amount, or 13 million Nairas, was released by the federal government.（声明日期：2019-10-02）
